duration.text: The Civil Engineering at Shenyang Jianzhu University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 200 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2083 USD/per year ￥ 15000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Application Form for International Students of Shenyang Jianzhu University2. The original or notarized document of the highest degree (fresh graduates must provide the graduation booking certificate issued by their school), in Chinese or English3. Undergraduate applicants shall provide original or notarized transcripts of all senior high school courses; postgraduate applicants shall provide original price or notarized transcripts of all undergraduate courses in Chinese or English4. Photocopy of passport, visa or residence permit6. A two-inch recent headless photo with a white background7.Certificates of various awards, including relevant certificates and certificates obtained in sports, arts, etc

requirements.text: All non-Chinese nationals who are at least 18 years of age, have a high school education or above, hold a foreign passport, are physically and mentally healthy, consciously abide by Chinese laws and school rules and regulations, and respect the customs and habits of the Chinese people are eligible to apply
